title: Quotient construction auxiliary
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_quotient_aux {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj) (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))) (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) : ∃ d : ℕ, c ≤ d ∧ ∃ (K : CoherentFormalModule X I) (ι : K ⟶ F) (e : ∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + d))) ≅ K.obj.obj (op n)), (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 2) (S.obj (op (n + 1 + d))) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom ≫ K.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op = S.map (homOfLE (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_succ n) d)).op ≫ formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + d))) ≫ (e n).hom) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (S.obj (op (n + d))) ≫ (e n).hom ≫ ι.hom.app (op n) = j.app (op (n + d)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n d)).op) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, kernel.ι (ι.hom.app (op (n + d))) ≫ K.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n d)).op = 0)

proof.text: Apply eventual adicness of the explicit shifted quotient and enlarge the input stabilization bound c to d = max c b. Package the explicitly constructed functor as K with that proof. Define iota by the explicit descended inclusion and take identity level isomorphisms. Cokernel projection equations prove the transition and inclusion equations.
Each component of j is monic by hS. Apply the proved cokernel-descent kernel-vanishing theorem.

statement_change.what: Image stabilization alone does not imply the kernel Artin--Rees bound. For Spec Z, I=(2), the reduction of the quotient system Z/2^(n+1) to the constant Z/2 system has stabilized termwise kernels already at c=0, but their prescribed quotients have levels 0 and Z/2 and cannot be adic. Allow an output d>=c chosen for the source-kernel Artin--Rees bound; this is what Stacks 087X does. No target signature changes.

old_proof.text: Use the stabilized image equality together with the affine formal-module equivalence and Artin--Rees calculation to construct the quotient system and prove eventual kernel vanishing.
